moments.title: The Hundred 2026 Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament is in full swing across the UK, with teams battling it out in the 100-ball format until the finals on August 16.

angles.name: Cricket Action
angles.copy: The Hundred is well underway! Catch up on all the big hits and wickets as the competition heats up across the UK.

angles.name: Team Rivalries
angles.copy: Which team are you backing in The Hundred? The action is non-stop as the tournament rolls on towards the finals next month.

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Friendlies
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are continuing their pre-season preparations with friendlies today and throughout the week, ahead of the new season starting August 21.

angles.name: Today's Games
angles.copy: Pre-season action today! Chelsea take on Western Sydney Wanderers in Sydney, while Aston Villa face Real Sociedad in Walsall. Who are you watching?

angles.name: New Season Buzz
angles.copy: The countdown to the Premier League season is on! Clubs are globetrotting for friendlies, building up to the big kick-off on August 21.

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Begins
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open, a major championship in professional golf, tees off on Thursday, July 30, at Royal Lytham & St Annes Golf Club in Lancashire.

angles.name: Major Golf Tees Off
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class golf! The AIG Women's Open begins Thursday at Royal Lytham & St Annes. Who's your pick for the Claret Jug?

angles.name: Lancashire Hosting
angles.copy: Lancashire is set to welcome golf's elite! The AIG Women's Open starts Thursday at Royal Lytham & St Annes.

moments.title: Major UK Music Festivals Kick Off
moments.blurb: A host of popular UK music festivals, including Camp Bestival, Wilderness, Belladrum Tartan Heart, Y-Not, Kendal Calling, and Good Vibrations Society, all begin this Thursday and Friday.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Festival season is truly here! Camp Bestival, Wilderness, Y-Not, Kendal Calling, and more all kick off this week. Which fields are you heading to?

angles.name: Dorset & Oxfordshire Festivals
angles.copy: Camp Bestival Dorset (Lulworth Castle) and Wilderness Festival (Oxfordshire) begin Thursday! Bastille, Fatboy Slim, Billy Ocean are among the acts.

angles.name: Scottish Highlands Festival
angles.copy: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival in the Scottish Highlands starts Thursday! James, The Human League, and Callum Beattie are set to headline.

moments.title: Grace Jones at Crystal Palace Bowl
moments.blurb: Iconic artist Grace Jones performs at London's Crystal Palace Bowl on Friday, July 31, with special guests Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul.

angles.name: Grace Jones Live
angles.copy: London! Grace Jones is bringing her legendary show to Crystal Palace Bowl this Friday, with Sophie Ellis-Bextor and Soul II Soul joining. Not to be missed!

angles.name: Friday Night Icon
angles.copy: The one and only Grace Jones takes the stage in London this Friday! Who's ready for an unforgettable night with a true legend?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Battle: Dai Dai vs Rein Me In
moments.blurb: The race for the UK Number 1 single is tight between Shakira and Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' and Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In', with the new chart announced this Friday, July 31.

angles.name: Chart Race Heats Up
angles.copy: Who will claim the Official UK Number 1 this Friday? Shakira & Burna Boy are battling Sam Fender & Olivia Dean for the top spot!

angles.name: Sam Fender vs Shakira
angles.copy: It's a huge chart battle this week! Can Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold off Shakira & Burna Boy for Number 1? Find out Friday!

moments.title: New Heatwave Forecast for UK
moments.blurb: The Met Office has issued a heatwave warning for parts of the UK, with temperatures in London expected to reach 33C on Wednesday, July 29, and more hot spells possible in August.

angles.name: Stay Cool This Week
angles.copy: Another heatwave is on the way! Temperatures could hit 33C in London on Wednesday. Stay hydrated and stay safe.

angles.name: Drought in Wales
angles.copy: A drought was declared in Wales last week, and more hot weather is expected. Remember to conserve water.

moments.title: Happy 33rd Birthday Cher Lloyd

angles.name: Cher Lloyd Turns 33
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Cher Lloyd who turns 33 today! What's your favourite track from the 'Swagger Jagger' star?

angles.name: Perrie's Big Day
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Little Mix's Perrie Edwards turns 33! What's your favourite Little Mix anthem to celebrate?

moments.title: Paul Anka's 85th Birthday

angles.name: Paul Anka at 85
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the incredible Paul Anka this Thursday! What's your favourite classic from him?

moments.title: Kate Bush Turns 68

angles.name: Happy Birthday Kate Bush
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the iconic Kate Bush this Thursday! What's your favourite track from her incredible catalogue?

moments.title: Fatboy Slim's 63rd Birthday

angles.name: Big Beat Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the legend, Fatboy Slim, this Friday! What's the track that gets you on the dancefloor?

moments.title: James Hetfield Turns 63

angles.name: Metallica Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield of Metallica turns 63 this Saturday. What's your ultimate Metallica track?

angles.name: Ginger Spice's Birthday
angles.copy: Girl Power! Geri Halliwell turns 54 this Tuesday. What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?
